Our automation framework

How we turn business tasks into smarter workflows.

Every AFM AUTOMATIONS solution follows a clear six-stage process. Each stage has a purpose, from the moment work enters a system to the final result your team or customer receives.

01 · START⚡TRIGGER

Something happens: a form is submitted, an order arrives or a customer sends a message.

02 · PREPARE🧩FORMATTER

We clean, organise and standardise the incoming information so it is ready to process.

03 · CHECK🔎FILTER

We apply rules to decide what should continue, where it should go and what needs attention.

04 · THINK🤖INTELLIGENCE

AI or business logic interprets the information, classifies it or selects the next best step.

05 · DO⚙️ACTION

The system performs the approved task, such as saving a record, sending a reply or notifying a team.

06 · DELIVER📬OUTPUT

The result reaches the right person or system, with a clear status or hand-off.

TRIGGER → FORMATTER → FILTER → INTELLIGENCE → ACTION → OUTPUT
We tailor each stage to the business process, tools and safeguards required. Human review can remain part of the workflow wherever approval or judgement is important.
Selected demonstrations

Business workflows, shown in action.

These are AFM-built demonstration scenarios using fictional businesses and sample data. They show the kind of workflow we can design; they are not client deployments, connected services or claimed business results.

DEMO 01 · RETAIL

Online store enquiry-to-order workflow

Business situation: A customer asks about a product through a website form. The team needs the enquiry captured, categorised and assigned for follow-up.

Website form→Validate details→Log lead→Notify team
Sample customerAmara Okafor
Product interestLeather handbag
Lead statusNew · Awaiting reply
Next actionSales follow-up
Automation logic
  1. Trigger when the enquiry form is submitted.
  2. Check required fields and email format.
  3. Add a row to a lead tracker (for example, Google Sheets).
  4. Send an internal notification with the enquiry summary.
  5. Prepare a customer acknowledgement for review or sending.

Possible tools: Tally · n8n · Google Sheets · Gmail. Live connection requires client-approved accounts and configuration.
